import os, tempfile
from grep import grep

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def w(name, text):
    p = os.path.join(d, name)
    with open(p, "w") as f:
        f.write(text)
    return p

a = w("a.txt", "alpha\nBeta\ngamma.x")   # no trailing newline
b = w("b.txt", "")                        # empty file
c = w("c.txt", "nothing here\n")

print(repr(grep("gamma", "", [a])))                       # no trailing NL -> adds \n
print(repr(grep("", "", [b])))                            # empty file -> ""
print(repr(grep("", "", [a])))                            # empty pattern matches all
print(repr(grep("BETA", "-i -x", [a])))                   # 2:Beta
print(repr(grep("beta", "-v -n", [a])))                   # invert + numbers
print(repr(grep("a", "-l", [a, b, c])))                   # only a.txt
print(repr(grep("zzz", "-l", [a, b, c])))                 # empty
print(repr(grep("a", "-n", [b, c])))                      # no matches
print(repr(grep("g.mma", "", [a])))                       # fixed string, not regex
print(repr(grep("a", "-l -n", [b, a])))                   # -l order/precedence
print(repr(grep("nothing", "-x -i", [c])))                # exact full line
EOF
